title: Is Sakana AI Actually Better Than Claude 3.5? The Truth About Fugu
description:
I've got some bad news about the new Sakana AI model that's claiming to beat benchmarks. Is Sakana AI better than Claude 3.5 Opus or Gemini 3.5? After some research, it turns out it's just a model router! In this video, I break down how they might be manipulating benchmarks by picking different models for different tasks. 

I also built a free open-source app on GitHub so you can test it yourself. Just type 'LINK' in the comments and I'll send it over!

#SakanaAI #AIAutomation #LLM #Claude3 #ArtificialIntelligence
